<!-- Code generated by xgen. DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!-- Source: xgen/screens/src/authoring/blocks/navigation.ts -->
<!--
  An app-style tab bar for a phone: an icon over a label per tab, the current one marked. Axes: labels (show,
  hide: icons only with the name hidden), position (static, sticky: stays at the bottom of the page), tone.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { NavLink } from "./nav-bar.types";

  export type BottomNavProps = {
    label: string;
    tabs: NavLink[];
    current?: string;
    labels?: "show" | "hide";
    position?: "static" | "sticky";
    tone?: "default" | "muted";
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Block from "../primitives/block/block.svelte";
  import Inline from "../primitives/inline/inline.svelte";
  import Link from "../primitives/link/link.svelte";
  import List from "../primitives/list/list.svelte";
  import ListItem from "../primitives/list/list-item.svelte";
  import LucideIcon from "../primitives/lucide-icon/lucide-icon.svelte";
  import { cn } from "../utils";

  let {
    label,
    tabs,
    current = "",
    labels = "show",
    position = "static",
    tone = "default",
  }: BottomNavProps = $props();
</script>

<Block
  tag="nav"
  class={cn(
    "mx-auto w-full max-w-md border-t border-border",
    (((tone as string) === "muted") ? "bg-muted" : "bg-background"),
    (((position as string) === "sticky") ? "sticky bottom-0 z-40" : "")
  )}
  aria-label={label}
  data-testid="bottom-nav"
  data-position={position}
>
  <List class="m-0 grid list-none grid-flow-col auto-cols-fr p-0" data-testid="items">
    {#each tabs as tab (tab.id)}
      <ListItem>
        <Link
          href="#/"
          variant="default"
          aria-current={((tab.id === current) ? "page" : undefined)}
          class={cn(
            "flex flex-col items-center gap-2 py-2 text-xs",
            ((tab.id === current) ? "font-semibold text-primary" : "text-muted-foreground")
          )}
          data-testid="item"
        >
          <LucideIcon name={tab.icon} size={20} />
          <Inline class={(((labels as string) === "hide") ? "sr-only" : "")}>
            {tab.name}
          </Inline>
        </Link>
      </ListItem>
    {/each}
  </List>
</Block>
